name: maths-study-hub
description: Spaced-repetition study app for Edexcel A-Level Maths. No build step — package.json exists only so `npm test` runs the pre-deploy validator and `npm run deploy` publishes.

scripts.test: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/gen-icon-index.mjs --check && node scripts/fsrs-replay-test.mjs && node scripts/fsrs-mistake-test.mjs && node scripts/fsrs-paper-test.mjs && node scripts/fsrs-exam-ramp-test.mjs
